captions.detailed: An independent front suspension axle assembly featuring a black tubular subframe with upper and lower wishbone arms. At each end, a gray steering knuckle carries a brake rotor flange and a wheel hub fitted with five protruding lug bolts. The wishbones connect to the subframe and knuckles via spherical ball-joint mounts, allowing realistic steering articulation and vertical suspension travel.
captions.instruction: Create an independent front suspension axle assembly in CadQuery. The model should include a black tubular subframe, upper and lower wishbone arms, and steering knuckles at each end supporting gray brake hubs with five lug bolts, complete with realistic joints for steering and suspension movement.
captions.factory: Construct the subframe using cylinders and swept profiles for the tubular crossmembers. Create the upper and lower wishbone arms as separate links using wire sweeps or extrusions. Model the steering knuckle with a central spindle and ball-joint sockets, and append a wheel hub assembly consisting of a brake rotor disc and five small cylinders for the lug bolts. Assemble the components using revolute and floating joints to connect the subframe, wishbones, knuckles, and rotating hubs.
